subject: infra.connect
name: Spectrum assignment and 5G licensing
what_would_settle_it: a UCC spectrum award notice or a National Radio Frequency Plan

subject: infra.store
name: National data-centre installed capacity
what_would_settle_it: a UCC or NITA-U facility register with MW or rack counts

subject: infra.energy
name: Grid power at national backbone sites
what_would_settle_it: a NITA-U or energy-ministry statement of how many backbone points of presence are grid-connected

subject: infra.capacity
name: National ICT and cybersecurity workforce baseline
what_would_settle_it: a UCC or NITA-U ICT skills survey, or a named certified-professional count

subject: gov.protect
name: PDPO action on election-period personal-data processing
what_would_settle_it: any data-protection decision, complaint-register entry or public statement on the January 2026 electoral processing

subject: geopol.eu
name: EU-Uganda bilateral digital cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: a Global Gateway country package, an EU-Uganda digital memorandum, or a financing agreement naming Uganda

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Uganda ICT sector output and employment series
what_would_settle_it: a statistics-bureau or UCC sector statistic, or the ICT ministry's development-plan sector targets

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital-literacy rate
what_would_settle_it: a statistics-bureau or UCC household ICT survey reporting a digital-literacy or digital-skills rate

subject: gov.legislate
name: Startup Bill
what_would_settle_it: the bill's text or gazetted draft, an order paper or committee report placing it in Parliament, or a ministerial statement of its timetable

subject: gov.legislate
name: Legal and regulatory framework for artificial intelligence
what_would_settle_it: an enacted statute, a gazetted regulation, or a named regulator with a mandate over artificial intelligence

subject: tech.ai
name: Rules governing automated decisions in hiring
what_would_settle_it: a statute, labour-code provision, data-protection guidance note or regulator determination naming automated or algorithmic decisions in recruitment would settle it; probed 2026-09-08, a four-country comparative legal review finds none in the constitution, the labour code or the data-protection act

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the 2025/26 digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: The Annual Budget Performance Report for FY2025/26, printing releases and spending by department and project; only the semi-annual report is held for that year.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Operating, hosting and exit terms of the national identity system contract
what_would_settle_it: Publication of NIRA's contract of 8 July 2024 with Tahaluf, or a NIRA or Auditor General statement, setting out who operates and hosts the system, what skills transfer it requires and on what terms it can be ended.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Text of the December 2025 health data agreement with the United States
what_would_settle_it: Publication by either government of the data-sharing agreement signed on 10 December 2025, stating the systems covered, the access granted, jurisdiction over the data and the terms of exit.
